TitlePart.Title: When your B2B site stops being just a website

Excerpt.Text: Most B2B companies start with a simple website. But as you grow, that website becomes a bottleneck. Here is how to recognize the signs and what to do next.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Most B2B companies start with a simple website. But as you grow, that website becomes a bottleneck.\r\n\r\nThis article covers the warning signs and the playbook for turning your site into a predictable growth engine.

data.DisplayText: How to structure case studies for trust and leads

Excerpt.Text: Case studies are powerful, but only if structured correctly. Learn the framework that converts prospects into qualified leads.

data.DisplayText: Knowledge base vs help center vs docs: what to build first

TitlePart.Title: Knowledge base vs help center vs docs: what to build first

Excerpt.Text: These terms are often used interchangeably, but they serve different purposes. Here is how to decide what your team needs.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Knowledge bases, help centers, and docs each solve different problems. Start with the one that removes the most friction for your customers today.\r\n\r\nThis guide explains the decision criteria and what to build next.

data.DisplayText: CMS migration without chaos: a phased roadmap

Excerpt.Text: Migrating your CMS does not have to be a nightmare. Follow this phased approach to minimize risk and downtime.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: A phased migration keeps teams aligned and reduces disruption.\r\n\r\nThis guide covers discovery, content mapping, and parallel run strategies.

data.DisplayText: Content audit checklist for B2B websites
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: Content audit checklist for B2B websites

Excerpt.Text: Before rebuilding your website, you need to know what you have. Use this checklist to audit your content effectively.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: A thorough audit uncovers gaps, duplicates, and outdated pages.\r\n\r\nStart with goals, map owners, and score each asset.

data.DisplayText: Why your support team needs a knowledge hub
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: Why your support team needs a knowledge hub

Excerpt.Text: Support teams waste hours answering the same questions. A knowledge hub changes that. Here is how to build one.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: A shared knowledge hub reduces repeat tickets and onboarding time.\r\n\r\nFocus on search, structure, and clear ownership.

data.DisplayText: Editorial workflows that keep marketing moving
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: Editorial workflows that keep marketing moving

Excerpt.Text: A predictable editorial workflow helps teams publish on time without sacrificing quality.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Set clear stages, owners, and review gates to keep work flowing.\r\n\r\nYour CMS should reinforce these steps, not fight them.

data.DisplayText: Designing service pages that sell without fluff
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: Designing service pages that sell without fluff

Excerpt.Text: Service pages should clarify outcomes, scope, and proof instead of hiding behind vague claims.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Focus on outcomes, the process, and evidence.\r\n\r\nMake it easy for buyers to self-qualify.

data.DisplayText: How to brief developers for content-heavy sites
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: How to brief developers for content-heavy sites

Excerpt.Text: Great implementation starts with a clear brief. Define the content model before anyone writes code.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Document content types, fields, and relationships upfront.\r\n\r\nThis prevents rework and keeps timelines stable.

data.DisplayText: From brochure to platform: evolving a marketing site
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: From brochure to platform: evolving a marketing site

Excerpt.Text: As content grows, your site must move beyond static pages. Here is a roadmap to evolve without a rebuild.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Add structure, search, and reusable components in phases.\r\n\r\nThis keeps momentum while expanding capabilities.

data.DisplayText: Building a B2B FAQ library that scales
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: Building a B2B FAQ library that scales

Excerpt.Text: A scalable FAQ library reduces support load and increases trust. Structure and governance make it work.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Group questions by intent, not internal teams.\r\n\r\nAssign owners and review dates to keep answers fresh.

data.DisplayText: Picking KPIs for content operations
data.Author: admin

Excerpt.Text: Content teams need leading indicators, not vanity metrics. Choose KPIs that map to outcomes.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Track production velocity, reuse, and time-to-publish.\r\n\r\nPair these with pipeline and revenue metrics.

data.DisplayText: Information architecture for complex offerings
data.Author: admin

Excerpt.Text: Complex offerings need clear navigation and naming. A strong IA keeps prospects from getting lost.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Start with customer language, then map pages to decisions.\r\n\r\nUse hubs and leaf pages to keep structure clear.

data.DisplayText: Planning content migrations with stakeholders
data.Author: admin

Excerpt.Text: Migration success depends on alignment. Bring stakeholders in early with clear timelines and roles.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Define owners for each content area and schedule reviews.\r\n\r\nTransparency prevents last-minute surprises.

data.DisplayText: What to document before switching CMS
data.Author: admin

TitlePart.Title: What to document before switching CMS

Excerpt.Text: The right documentation reduces migration risk. Capture content rules, redirects, and ownership now.

MarkdownBodyPart.Markdown: Document page inventories, metadata standards, and redirect plans.\r\n\r\nThis prevents content loss and SEO dips.
